notes.LA24: Layer 13 DeltaNet mixer is mid-stack with a typical out_proj norm of 16.77 and A_log values near -1 (e.g. -1.3125, -2.2031); single mid mixer skip should be mild, slightly larger on in-context prompts P0/P1/P3.
notes.LA25: Layer 0 mixer: input norm gain index 0 is +1.000 (double the rest) and dt_bias reaches -13.0625 and +8.3750, indicating a first-layer sublayer the whole stack is conditioned on; skipping it should hurt heavily but less than removing the whole block.
notes.LA26: Layer 21 DeltaNet mixer has out_proj norm 16.78 and smooth input gains around +0.7 (max 1.469 at idx 74); a late single mixer skip should cause small shifts, mostly on fragile P7.
notes.LA27: Layer 14 MLP has the smallest down_proj norm in the model (15.14) with gate_proj 26.20; top neuron column norm only 0.448, so skipping it should be the mildest MLP edit, with P4 factual recall slightly more affected.
notes.LA28: Layer 21 MLP is a strong late MLP (gate_proj 32.91, down_proj 17.70, top column norm 0.469 at neuron 3519); late MLPs sharpen output logits so expect moderate drops, most on P4 and P7.
notes.LA29: Layer 3 is the first full-attention block with o_proj 17.63 and an unusually large early gate_proj 31.25; removing both mixer and MLP this early should propagate broadly, hurting in-context prompts and fragile P7 most.
notes.LA30: Layer 23 whole block has the largest gate_proj (36.18) and up_proj (21.25) norms plus o_proj 20.06 and the weakest dimension-0 gain (+0.052); the final block shapes the output distribution, so expect sizable drops and frequent flips on low-margin prompts.
notes.LA31: Layer 5 is an early DeltaNet block (mixer_in 44.48, gate_proj 27.96, dt_bias as low as -6.5000); early whole-block removal should give moderate-to-large damage, below layer 3 but well above mid layers.
notes.LA32: Layer 17 MLP has gate_proj 32.16 and down_proj 16.39 with top column norm 0.373 at neuron 2886; a mid-late MLP skip should be modest, with P4 factual recall the most sensitive.
notes.LA33: Layer 0 whole block removal takes out the mixer with extreme dt_bias (-13.0625) and the MLP (gate_proj 23.21, down_proj 16.28) that acts as an extended embedding; this should be catastrophic across all prompts with near-certain flips.
notes.LA34: Layer 18 block has the largest mixer_in norm (58.91) but the smallest out_proj (14.64), with gate_proj 33.99 and dt_bias range -6.2188 to +4.4688; whole-block removal in the late-middle should be moderate, larger on P4 and P7.
notes.LA35: Layer 23 attention alone has o_proj norm 20.06 (second largest) and q-proj norm 33.59; final-layer attention removal should be a moderate hit, mostly on in-context P0 and fragile P7, while the P6 prior survives.
